caption: The drawing features two sculpted objects resembling elongated wooden branches topped with clusters of leaves. Each object is shown in a slightly different orientation, revealing different angles of the same item. The leaves are oval-shaped with visible vein patterns, arranged densely around the upper parts of the branches. On the left object, there are three rounded, fruit-like elements amongst the leaves. Both objects display natural wood-brown tones and are set against a plain, light-beige background. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a small, monochrome sketch showing a simplified, upright version of the same sculpted object placed in a decorative base. There are light inscriptions beneath and adjacent to the drawing and sketch, indicating labels and possible measurements.
title: Wood Carving
